Hi Candidate,

Thank you for taking the time to consider Axon as your next employer. We wanted to let you know that our hiring team has reviewed your application for the Senior Director, IT Business Solutions & Delivery role and decided to proceed with other candidates for the position at this time. We will be advertising more positions in the coming months as we continue to grow and we’d encourage you to apply again in the future.

We appreciate your interest in Axon and wish you success in your job search.

Thank you,
Axon Talent Acquisition Team
